meta_desc: People & Operations Adventure 1 — KS3 Business Studies on staff, recruitment and motivation basics.
final_note: You learned who works in a business, how staff are recruited and what motivates them.

concepts.def: A person paid to work for a business
The business or owner who pays staff
Teaching staff how to do the job
Reasons people want to work hard

walkthroughs.body_html:
The employer hires people. The employee works for pay.

Big businesses have many roles — managers, designers, sellers, cleaners. Each role is vital.

Recruitment is finding new staff. The steps:

  • Write a job description.
  • Advertise the job.
  • Read CVs.
  • Interview the best.
  • Offer the job.

Once hired, new staff need training. 📚

Why work hard? Reasons include:

  • Good pay.
  • A friendly team.
  • Interesting work.
  • Praise and promotion.
  • Job security.

Motivated staff stay longer and serve customers better. 😀
